review.summary: Original CSV parsing loads 62 tags; independent world-loop fixtures match 60 movement ticks and 240 melee tick records, including shield and no-attack controls. Published native parser and combat probes remain explicitly synthetic and do not establish full-match equivalence.

evidence: Base and ARM64 split pass APK v3 and SourceStamp verification; manifest reports 160402020.

Signed build-160402020 install-time pack acquired; all 17,307 fingerprint entries match (10,719 ZIP files and 6,588 SQLite BLOBs), including 389/389 csv_logic files. Later live updates remain unverified.
JADX processed 9,575 input classes with 200 errors; startup and JNI declarations recovered.
libg ELF metadata yields 566 dynamic-symbol entries including createGameMain and JNI_OnLoad.
Decoded configuration identifies /proc/self/maps, the supporting library, and dispatch offset 0x681780.

Public tools recover support, 416 selectors and libg from pinned inputs. Original CSV parsing and tag registration now load 62 tags with identical independent image output. Full native/Android and battle-data initialization remain incomplete.
All 160/160 original checksums match across the 184,872-byte protection-runtime tail region; a one-bit negative control leaves 159/160 matches. This checks recovered bytes, not battle equivalence.

Original movement and actor state updates execute for 60 native world ticks on a synthetic single-actor arena; all recorded fields match independent runs. Real arenas, complete troop state and full-match equivalence remain unvalidated.
No target acquisition algorithm has been recovered.
Original arena collision and neighbor search execute during 60 synthetic movement ticks. Complete troop overlap, pushing and avoidance behavior remains unvalidated.

Original world loop executes three 80-tick melee fixtures, scheduling attacks and damage itself. All 240 selected tick records match independent runs, including shield and no-attack controls; synthetic setup, projectiles and full-match parity remain open.
Authentic tower configuration is available; tower targeting, attack timing, and damage behavior remain unrecovered and unvalidated.
No complete per-tick state/event comparison against the original pinned battle runtime has been run. Byte-identical interactions remain a hard gate before policy training.
